How Much Does a Local Move Cost?

How to estimate a local move and what affects the final price.

Author: Ralph Ivey

Last updated: 2026-07-20

Experience: Written for working trucking and moving businesses.

Answer

Local move pricing usually depends on labor, truck size, stairs, distance, and how much packing or special handling is needed.

What to do next
